backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing user profile management, Stripe payment integration, blob storage, and role-based access control with admin/user permissions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three color scheme redesign features targeting frontend/index.css, dashboard components, sidebar, and landing page with vibrant playful colors.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files describing components, pages, hooks, and their CSS animations, color schemes, and functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes with neutral grayscale palette for UI components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx for the Propfolio application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with all routes (landing, dashboard, admin), ThemeProvider, fade-in animations, and Toaster notifications.
frontend/src/components/AddAccountDialog: Modal dialog for adding prop firm accounts with animated form fields, custom firm input, validation, and gradient styling with CSS animations.
frontend/src/components/AdminProtectedRo: Protected route wrapper checking localStorage for admin session token and redirecting to login if unauthenticated, with loading state.
Main dashboard layout component that handles authentication state, displays login screen for unauthenticated users, and renders sidebar with outlet and profile setup modal for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with animated background, brand section, social media links, quick links, and legal links including privacy policy and refund policy.
frontend/src/components/LoadingSpinner.t: Reusable loading spinner component with configurable size (sm/md/lg) using Lucide's Loader2 icon.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that handles login/logout with Internet Identity, manages loading states, and clears query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for new users to complete their profile with required fields (username, full name, email, mobile, Discord user ID) using form validation and mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/PropFirmTicker.t: Animated horizontal ticker component that displays prop firm names in a continuous scrolling loop with hover pause functionality.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Navigation sidebar with 17 menu items (dashboard, accounts, payouts, expenses, etc.) featuring gradient colors, active state highlighting, and animated transitions.
frontend/src/components/SkeletonCard.tsx: Loading skeleton component with four variants (metric, account, payout, default) for displaying placeholder content during data fetching.
frontend/src/constants/propFirms.ts: Exported sorted array of 60+ prop firm names including FTMO, Apex Trader Funding, Topstep, and others.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages backend actor instances with Internet Identity authentication, initializes access control, and invalidates dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Defines a React Query hook to fetch the current user's profile (username, email, social links, etc.) from the backend actor. Currently returns null as a placeholder until backend implementation is complete.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle. Includes status tracking (initializing, logging-in, success, error) and configurable options for identity provider and delegation.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: Defines a React Query mutation hook to save user profile data to the backend actor. Currently updates the query cache directly as a placeholder until backend implementation is complete.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom design tokens for light/dark themes using OKLCH color space, including vibrant primary/secondary/accent colors, utility classes for gradients and glows, and keyframe animations for floating and pulsing effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the root React component with QueryClientProvider for React Query and InternetIdentityProvider for ICP authentication.
